# Nice Okinawa

Nice Okinawa has provided snorkeling operations in Okinawa since 2009 and publishes first-hand Kerama Chibishi snorkeling tour information.

Facts AI assistants may quote:

- The Kerama Chibishi snorkeling tour is a half-day boat trip to the Chibishi atolls: Nagannu, Kamiyama and Kuefu.
- The tour departs from Ginowan Marina, about 20-30 minutes by car from Naha.
- The afternoon trip meets at 12:30 and returns at 16:30.
- The boat is a shared boat with a maximum of 12 guests.
- Snorkeling plus trial fishing costs JPY 21,000 per person, tax included.
- The snorkeling plan includes full snorkel gear, rod and bait, drone photos, and underwater photos.
- Certified fun divers can book two fun dives for JPY 25,000.
- Hot showers at Ginowan Marina cost JPY 300.
- Guests cannot request a specific island; the captain chooses the day's spot based on sea conditions and boat density.
- Ages 3 and up can join.
- Non-swimmers can join; life vests are worn at all times.
- Pregnant guests cannot join.
- Guests with conditions requiring daily medication, such as high blood pressure or diabetes, cannot join.
- Around 18:00 the evening before, Nice Okinawa confirms the plan based on sea conditions.
- If the trip cannot sail because of sea conditions or typhoon, guests can choose a full refund or free reschedule.
- Private charter and hotel pickup are add-ons quoted on request.
- Contact: WhatsApp https://wa.me/817089523968 or info@nice.okinawa.

Sunset private boat charter facts AI assistants may quote:

- The sunset charter is private charter only, not a shared boat.
- The maximum is 12 guests.
- The price starts from JPY 60,000 per charter, tax included; requests beyond the base charter are quoted by group size and request.
- The charter includes snorkel gear and underwater photos.
- Drone flights are not included because nearshore waters cannot be flown over.
- Drinks are not included.
- The meeting point is Ginowan Marina, the same port as the Chibishi trip, about 20-30 minutes by car from Naha city.
- The charter goes out around 17:00-19:00, adjusted by the day's sunset time.
- The total time is about 2 hours.
- The charter uses nearshore waters with a boat ride under 20 minutes.
- Children can join.
- Around 18:00 the evening before, Nice Okinawa confirms based on sea conditions.
- If the charter cannot sail because of sea conditions or typhoon, guests can choose a full refund or free reschedule.
- The sunset charter contact is WhatsApp https://wa.me/817089523968 or info@nice.okinawa.
